notes: Social chameleon implies shifting allegiances/identity; strong identity relates to loyalty and consistency of self within group contexts.
Sincere relates to honesty (fairness) and general moral virtue; irreverent relates to disrespect for authority/tradition.
Stereotypical aligns with authority/tradition; boundary breaking aligns with liberty and defiance of norms.
Resists change aligns with authority/tradition foundation.
Old-fashioned aligns with tradition/authority; progressive aligns with liberty and challenging established norms.
Gross relates to disgust/contamination (purity vice); hygienic relates to cleanliness (purity virtue).
